text.p: ContiFinancial Corp said on Thursday that it has priced a primary offering of 2.8 million shares of its common stock at $33 per share, raising a total of $92.4 million.
It said in a statement the offering was underwritten by Merrill Lynch & Co. and Bear Stearns & Co Inc.

The issuance of the shares will reduce Continental Grain Company's ownership of ContiFinancial from approximately 81 percent to approximately 76 percent, excluding the exercise of underwriters' over-allotment options, ContiFinancial said.
A total of 47.2 million shares of common stock will be outstanding after the offerings, excluding the over-allotment options.

Net proceeds of the offering will be used by the company for general corporate purposes, including strategic acquisitions, funding loan originations and purchases, supporting securitization transactions, and other working capital needs, ContiFinancial said.
